newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal to delay TAP fleet announcement.
newsitem.headline: Portugal to delay TAP fleet announcement.

text.p: The Portuguese government will delay until the end of next week the announcement of the winner of a competition to provide a new medium haul fleet for state airline TAP-Air Portugal, a spokesman said.

"Due to the difficulty to arrange a date for the TAP general assembly, which has to authorise the operation (to acquire new planes), it was decided to postpone the public announcement until October 24 or 25," the spokesman told Reuters.
The government had said it would announce on Friday the winner of the competition. The bidders are U.S. group Boeing and European plane consortium Airbus Industrie.
